comment: Manual additions on top of Spring AOT-generated hints. Spring's ErrorHandlingDeserializer Java-serializes the caught deserialization exception (via ObjectOutputStream) to pass it downstream as a Kafka record header. This is a runtime-only code path (only triggered by an actual malformed message), so Spring AOT's static analysis never traces it, and native-image fails with UnsupportedFeatureError (SerializationConstructorAccessor not found for java.lang.Throwable) the first time a poison-pill message is consumed in production. Registering the exception hierarchy for serialization here fixes it without needing a real bad message during the AOT build/tracing-agent run.
